name: PM-USP Central Sector Scholarship for College and University Students

eligibilityCriteria.sourceText: Fresh applicants must rank above the 80th percentile among successful Class XII candidates in their board and stream.
The annual family income ceiling is ₹4.5 lakh.
Fresh applicants cannot receive another scholarship or fee reimbursement.
For fresh applications, confirm first-year admission to a regular degree after completing Class XII in the previous academic year. Diploma and gap-year applicants are excluded.

requiredDocuments.name: Category or caste certificate
requiredDocuments.condition: Fresh application in a reserved category.

name: PM YASASVI Top Class College Education for OBC, EBC and DNT Students

eligibilityCriteria.sourceText: The college scheme covers OBC, EBC and DNT students.
Total annual family income from all sources may be up to ₹2.5 lakh.
Check full-time admission to an eligible course at an institution notified for this cycle, along with merit and available slots.
At most two siblings in a family can receive this benefit.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities

eligibilityCriteria.sourceText: The scholarship is open to Indian nationals.
A benchmark disability of at least 40% must be certified by the competent authority.
The post-matric parental income ceiling is ₹2.5 lakh annually.
Verify eligible studies from Class XI through qualifying postgraduate courses. Confirm any applicable repeat-year, sibling and other scholarship or stipend restrictions.

name: Karnataka DTE Post-Matric Fee Reimbursement for ST Students

eligibilityCriteria.sourceText: This record covers the Scheduled Tribe reimbursement described in the circular.
Check the applicable income band cited in the circular as ₹2.5 lakh to ₹10 lakh. Confirm treatment of the boundary amounts with DTE and SSP.
Confirm an eligible Karnataka diploma, engineering, architecture or postgraduate course and the applicable admission route. Donation and management-quota seats are excluded.

requiredDocuments.name: Annual family income certificate RD number
Salary certificate, pension certificate, or income tax return certificate
requiredDocuments.condition: As applicable to the parent or guardian's income source.

name: Karnataka DTE Scholarship for Dependents of Defence Personnel

eligibilityCriteria.sourceText: Check the applicant's dependency and the service member's eligible Indian Army, Navy or Air Force rank under the circular and certificate notes.
Confirm an eligible polytechnic diploma, BE, BTech or BArch admission. Check the allowed seat and counselling route against the circular.

requiredDocuments.name: Defence service certificate signed by the competent authority
